lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a grid-like pattern along the mid-lateral line, extending from posterior of the gill slits to the caudal peduncle, with higher concentration in the mid-body region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal lines of similar intensity, creating a grid where circular high-luminance blobs act as anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient showing highlights on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs, primarily localized near the posterior margin and the base of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the left pectoral fin displays a dense, randomized constellation of high-luminance spots and vermiculated patterns that differ in density and size from the lateral flank constellation.
